highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: CISA sets urgent deadline to fix Cisco flaw exploited in attacks and Mandiant reveals how Cisco SD-WAN zero-day attacks gained root access. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: Clean GitHub repo tricks AI coding agents into running malware. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
identity_and_edge_access_risks: Polymarket customers lose $3 million in supply-chain attack. Prioritize MFA enforcement, phishing-resistant authentication, and reduce management-plane exposure for edge services and remote access.
